caption: On the Free plan we asked What is your return policy? The bot said it had no return details and told the shopper to email the store. The store name and that address are hidden.
The Show me best sellers chip returned four product cards on the Free plan, although the App Store listing puts best seller suggestions on Starter.
Sync policies reported 1 policy page synced. AskNest says it answers from FAQs first, then product data, then policy pages. The store name is hidden.
The same return question after the policy sync got the same kind of reply: no details, please email the store. The sync did not change the answer. The address and store name are hidden.
The plans inside the app: Free with 50 AI replies a month, Starter $4.99 with 500, Growth $9.99 with 1,500 and Pro $19.99 with 5,000. We stayed on Free.
Shopify's approval screen for Starter: $4.99 every 30 days plus any taxes, first charge due on the day of our test, with no free trial. We did not approve it.
